query:
-- Find the buyer who paid for BOXIUM-20260330-7825 and the listing
SELECT o.buyerId, o.listingId, o.orderNo, o.orderStatus, ci.id as cartItemId
FROM marketplaceOrders o
LEFT JOIN cartItems ci ON ci.userId = o.buyerId AND ci.listingId = o.listingId
WHERE o.orderNo = 'BOXIUM-20260330-7825';
